question_cn: 你觉得这份新工作怎么样？
question_en: What do you think of this new job?

options.A: 虽然工资不高，但是能学到很多东西。
options.B: 这份工作是上个月开始的。

explanation: '觉得……怎么样'询问主观评价，A是综合评价（让步转折）。B回答时间，C描述同事，D说时长，均不是对工作的整体评价。

question_en: What do you think of online shopping?
explanation: '怎么看待'询问观点/评价，A是主观评价。B是行为描述，C是客观陈述，D是事实描述，均不匹配。

question_en: Why have you been late so often recently?
explanation: '怎么总是迟到'询问迟到原因，A直接解释原因（堵车）。B、C、D虽然可能是间接原因，但A是最直接、最常见的迟到理由。

question_en: I heard you're going abroad to study?
explanation: '听说……'是确认信息的句式，A直接确认并补充信息。B是否认（与'听说'语境矛盾），C是评论，D转移话题，均不匹配。

question_cn: 这道题你是怎么做出来的？
question_en: How did you solve this problem?
explanation: '怎么做出来的'询问方法/方式，A回答具体方法（用计算器）。B是评价，C是时间，D是结果，均不匹配。

question_cn: 你觉得学汉语最难的是什么？
question_en: What do you think is the hardest part of learning Chinese?

options.D: 汉语在世界上使用的人很多。

explanation: '最难的是什么'询问主观感受，A是主观判断。B是客观事实，C是时长，D是背景信息，均不匹配。

question_cn: 你为什么把会议取消了？
question_en: Why did you cancel the meeting?
explanation: '为什么'询问原因，A用'因为'直接回答原因。B是结果，C是个人意愿（通常不是取消会议的正当理由），D是可能原因但不如A正式。

question_cn: 你比较喜欢吃中餐还是西餐？
question_en: Do you prefer Chinese food or Western food?
explanation: '比较……还是……'要求明确选择，A直接选择。B未明确选择，C、D是评价但未回答自己的选择。

question_cn: 你打算怎么处理这个问题？
question_en: How do you plan to handle this problem?

options.A: 我想先跟经理商量一下。

explanation: '怎么处理'询问解决方案，A回答具体做法。B、C、D都是描述/评价，不涉及处理方法。

question_cn: 你觉得这次考试能及格吗？
question_en: Do you think you can pass this exam?

options.A: 应该没问题，我复习得很充分。

explanation: '能及格吗'询问可能性，A直接回答可能性（没问题）并给出理由。B回答时间，C是评价，D说报名，均不匹配。

question_en: He ______ finish his homework ______ go to sleep.
explanation: '一……就……'表示两个动作紧接发生，'一做完就去睡觉'=as soon as he finishes, he goes to sleep。B表递进，C表转折，D表因果，均不匹配。

question_en: ______ you work hard, you may not necessarily succeed.
explanation: '即使……也……'表让步，'即使努力也不一定能成功'=even if you work hard, you may not succeed。B表因果，C表条件（与'不一定'矛盾），D表递进，均不匹配。

question_cn: 这个问题______讨论过好几次了。
question_en: This issue ______ been discussed several times already.
explanation: '已经……过'表示经历完成，'已经讨论过好几次'=has already been discussed several times。'正在'表现在进行，'总是'表频率，'马上'表将来，均不匹配。

question_en: He ______ talks ______ laughs, looking very relaxed.
explanation: '一边……一边……'表示两个动作同时进行，'一边说一边笑'=talking and laughing at the same time。B表递进，C表因果，D表转折，均不匹配。

question_cn: 这部电影______有趣，______让人感动。
question_en: This movie ______ interesting, ______ moving.
explanation: '不但……而且……'表递进，'不但有趣而且感人'=not only interesting but also moving。B表转折，C表因果，D表假设，均不匹配。

question_en: Why ______ you tell him about this?
explanation: 句末有问号，且语境是询问原因，'为什么'最合适。'怎么'问方式，'什么'问事物，'哪儿'问地点，均不匹配。

question_en: He writes characters ______ very neatly.
explanation: '得'用于动词和补语之间，'写得很整齐'中'很整齐'是'写'的补语。'的'表修饰，'地'表状语，'了'表完成，均不匹配。

question_en: ______ he was sick, ______ he didn't come to class.
explanation: 前句是原因（生病），后句是结果（没来上课），用'因为……所以……'。B表转折，C表假设，D表递进，均不匹配。

question_en: He ______ is taller than me, ______ is stronger than me.
explanation: 两个比较句并列递进，'不但比我高，而且比我壮'=not only taller but also stronger。B表转折，C表因果，D表假设，均不匹配。

question_en: ______ it rains tomorrow, the sports meet will be cancelled.
explanation: '如果……就……'表假设条件，'如果下雨就取消'=if it rains, it will be cancelled。B表因果，C表转折，D表递进，均不匹配。

question_en: He put the book ______ the table.
explanation: '放'是放置物品的动作，'放在桌子上'=put on the table。B、C、D的主语通常是人或动物，不用于书。

question_cn: 这个问题______他来说很容易。
question_en: This problem is easy ______ him.
explanation: '对……来说'是固定结构，表示'对于某人'。'对他来说很容易'=is easy for him。'给'、'向'、'从'均不匹配。

question_en: What does '突然' (tūrán) mean?
explanation: A表示事情发生得很急促、出乎意料。B表示事情发生得很缓慢。C表示经过很长时间终于发生。D表示事情经常发生。

question_en: What is the relationship between '保护' (bǎohù) and '破坏' (pòhuài)?
explanation: A表示意义相反，'保护'是维护，'破坏'是毁坏。B表示意思相同。C表示意思接近。D表示没有关系。

question_en: What is the opposite of '熟悉' (shúxī / familiar)?
explanation: A表示不认识、不了解，是'熟悉'的反义。B表示看得清楚。C表示理解明白。D表示对情况知道得很清楚。

question_en: What does '浪费' (làngfèi) mean?
explanation: A表示不节约、过度使用。B表示节省、不浪费。C表示使用某物。D表示需要某物。

question_en: What does '鼓掌' (gǔzhǎng) mean?
explanation: A表示用双手拍击发出声音，表示欢迎或赞赏。B表示挥动手臂打招呼。C表示两人伸手相握。D表示两人拥抱。

question_en: What is the difference between '参加' (cānjiā) and '参与' (cānyù)?

options.A: The first is for specific events; the second is for abstract matters
options.C: The first is written; the second is spoken
options.D: The first is a verb; the second is a noun

explanation: A表示'参加'多用于具体活动如会议，'参与'多用于抽象事务如决策。B表示两者意思完全一样。C表示一个是书面语一个是口语。D表示一个是动词一个是名词。

question_cn: '影响'作为名词时是什么意思？
question_en: What does '影响' (yǐngxiǎng) mean as a noun?
explanation: A表示对人或事物产生的作用。B表示事情发生的原因。C表示事情发展的结局。D表示需要解决的困难。

question_en: What kind of attitude does '认真' (rènzhēn) describe?
explanation: A形容做事专心细致、不马虎。B形容做事随便、不严肃。C形容心情愉快。D形容精神紧张不安。

passage_cn: 小王是一名大学生，他学的是计算机专业。除了上课，他还参加了一个编程社团。社团每周六下午有活动，大家一起学习新技术，做项目。小王觉得在社团里能学到很多课堂上学不到的东西。
passage_en: Xiao Wang is a university student majoring in computer science. Besides attending classes, he also joined a programming club. The club has activities every Saturday afternoon where members learn new technologies and work on projects together. Xiao Wang thinks he can learn many things in the club that he can't learn in class.
question_cn: 小王为什么参加编程社团？
question_en: Why did Xiao Wang join the programming club?

options.A: 因为他觉得能学到课堂上学不到的东西。
options.B: 因为他想认识更多朋友。

explanation: 文中最后一句明确说明'能学到很多课堂上学不到的东西'。B、C、D文中均未提及。

passage_cn: 近年来，越来越多的人选择骑自行车上班。一方面，骑自行车可以锻炼身体；另一方面，也是一种环保的出行方式。不过，下雨天骑车就不太方便了。
passage_en: In recent years, more and more people choose to ride bicycles to work. On one hand, cycling can exercise the body; on the other hand, it's also an environmentally friendly way to travel. However, riding in the rain is not very convenient.
question_cn: 骑自行车上班有什么好处？
question_en: What are the benefits of cycling to work?
explanation: 文中提到'一方面可以锻炼身体，另一方面也是环保的出行方式'。B文中未提，C与文中'下雨天不太方便'矛盾，D文中未提。

passage_cn: 张阿姨退休后，开始学习画画。她说，年轻时工作忙，没有时间发展自己的爱好。现在终于有时间了，她想好好学一学。虽然起步晚，但她很有耐心，每天都练习几个小时。
passage_en: After retiring, Aunt Zhang started learning to paint. She said when she was young, work was busy and she had no time to develop her hobbies. Now she finally has time and wants to learn properly. Although she started late, she is very patient and practices several hours every day.
question_cn: 张阿姨什么时候开始学画画的？
question_en: When did Aunt Zhang start learning to paint?
explanation: 文中第一句'退休后，开始学习画画'。B、C、D均与原文不符。

passage_cn: 现在很多人喜欢用手机看书，因为随时随地都可以阅读，而且书的价格也比纸质书便宜。但是，长时间看手机对眼睛不好。所以，专家建议每看30分钟就休息一下。
passage_en: Nowadays many people like reading books on their phones because they can read anytime, anywhere, and e-books are cheaper than paper books. However, looking at phones for a long time is bad for the eyes. So experts recommend taking a break every 30 minutes.
question_cn: 专家为什么建议每30分钟休息一下？
question_en: Why do experts recommend taking a break every 30 minutes?

options.A: 因为长时间看手机对眼睛不好。
options.D: 因为休息可以提高阅读效率。

explanation: 文中明确说'长时间看手机对眼睛不好。所以，专家建议每看30分钟就休息一下'。B、C、D文中均未提及。

passage_cn: 李华上周去了一趟云南旅行。那里的风景非常美丽，空气也很清新。他拍了很多照片，还品尝了当地的特色美食。唯一遗憾的是，因为时间不够，他没有去成丽江古城。
passage_en: Li Hua traveled to Yunnan last week. The scenery there was very beautiful and the air was fresh. He took many photos and tasted local specialty foods. The only regret was that he didn't get to visit Lijiang Ancient Town because he didn't have enough time.
question_cn: 李华为什么没去丽江古城？
question_en: Why didn't Li Hua visit Lijiang Ancient Town?
explanation: 文中最后一句'因为时间不够，他没有去成丽江古城'。B、C、D文中均未提及。
